steps.title: Define App Metadata and Configuration
steps.description: Configure app meta-information such as app name and package name in app-meta.json.

steps.title: Configure Root Gradle Settings
steps.description: Set up project-level name and subproject structures within settings.gradle.

steps.title: Define Buildscript Dependencies
steps.description: Configure root build.gradle to fetch resources from Google and Maven Central with Android Gradle Plugin version 8.3.2.

steps.title: Configure App-Level Build Script
steps.description: Set compiler and target versions to Android SDK 34, and Java version compatibility to Java 8.

steps.title: Set Up Android Application Manifest
steps.description: Declare the main application activity with proper namespace validation and set the main action launcher.

steps.title: Define Material Color Palette
steps.description: Specify material-design compatible white, dark, gray, and primary blue colors inside colors.xml.

steps.title: Define String Resources
steps.description: Create string labels for buttons, text titles, hint states, and input validation warnings.

steps.title: Create Rounded Edit Text Background
steps.description: Design a shape xml drawable for the input text field featuring soft rounded corners and light borders.

steps.title: Create Premium Rounded Button Background
steps.description: Design a selector state drawable that changes shades on press event for the blue save button.

steps.title: Create Card Container Background
steps.description: Create a rounded light gray background drawable to house the saved note content.

steps.title: Design Application UI Layout
steps.description: Write activity_main.xml structure utilizing ScrollView and LinearLayout to ensure high responsiveness on all screens.

steps.title: Define Header and Description UI Nodes
steps.description: Add visual hierarchy texts to the top section of the main layout, rendering application purpose.

steps.title: Integrate Input and Button Elements
steps.description: Incorporate the custom styled EditText and Save Button into the UI layout structure.

steps.title: Integrate Saved Result Section
steps.description: Append the saved note card visual elements at the bottom of the main layout.

steps.title: Implement Main Native Activity
steps.description: Write MainActivity.java using pure Java 8 syntax and wire UI variables to resources.

steps.title: Integrate SharedPreferences Storage System
steps.description: Implement local persistence to save notes offline and load them upon application initialization.

steps.title: Add UI Interaction and Validation Logic
steps.description: Implement interactive click listener using anonymous class with validation warning on empty text entries.

steps.title: Building Quick Notes
steps.description: Compile raw resources and build the final native Android application package.
